4885-5078-6650-8171.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
4885-5078-6650-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

654-1018-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-1018-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Skullwinder and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Skullwinder and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-1018-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Skullwinder and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-1303-2033-3249--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1303-2033-3249--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the zombie castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that zombie spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that zombie or when it enters, Necroduality triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3951-4247-5703-5929.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3951-4247-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

2728-4153-5231-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-4153-5231-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-4153-5231-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1991-3259-7297.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1991-3259-7297.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3010-3259-4460.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3010-3259-4460.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2292-4302-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2292-4302-5929.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4499-6633-6723-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1298-1618-2440-7375.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Arc Blade.
Arc Blade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Ovika triggers, creating a number of creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token for each trigger.
Resolve Arc Blade.
Repeat.

2146-3532-5078-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2146-3532-5078-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

997-4559-7096-7306.easyPrerequisites: You've had two or more lands enter this turn.
997-4559-7096-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
997-4559-7096-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1395-4050-5078-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

586-4943-7070.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Gix.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Priest of Gix.
The Lancers en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

339-677-2079-2438.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Temur Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

339-677-969-5147.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1387-1500-3940-4258.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {R}. Birgi, Haze of Rage's storm ability, Blood Funnel and Sedgemoor Witch trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Sedgemoor Witch trigger, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, creating a copy of it for each spell cast before it this turn.
If you created copies of Haze of Rage this way, Sedgemoor Witch triggers for each copy, creating that many 1/1 Pest creature tokens.
Resolve all Haze of Rage spells.
Repeat.

2604-4316-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1429-5231-6792.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-647-2043-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

224-3861-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

880-2757-3534.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control an additional creature.
880-2757-3534.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1737-3698-4242-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {4} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
When the token Su-Chi enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Grinding Station by sacrificing Su-Chi and tapping it.
When Su-Chi dies, Su-Chi and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

654-1479-2907-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-2907-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and each Scute Swarm you control trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve a Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve a Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2506-6184.description:
Cast Unstoppable Ash by paying its mana cost.
When Unstoppable Ash enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Molten Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Unstoppable Ash with haste.
When the Unstoppable Ash token enters the battlefiled, its champion ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Unstoppable Ash until the token Unstoppable Ash leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the champion ability from step 2, exiling the token Unstoppable Ash.
The token Unstoppable Ash leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Unstoppable Ash from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-3680--39.notablePrerequisites: Stunt Double is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-3680--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Stunt Double trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

3845-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
3845-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.

803-1219-1409-2348-4438.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five lands, plus additional lands that do not have summoning sickness and can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Beledros.
"Cleric" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1219-1409-2348-4438.description:
Activate Ancestor's Prophet by tapping five lands you control, causing you to gain 10 life.
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Beledros by paying 10 life, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Beledros by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Beledros enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Beledros.
Repeat.
If the additional lands can tap to produce at least {2}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1379-1543-3364-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Arlinn has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
1379-1543-3364-4312.description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Arlinn.
Activate Arlinn by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

225-539-5077-5235.notablePrerequisites:
Scaretiller is untapped.
You have a basic Island, Forest or Plains in library.
225-539-5077-5235.description:
Play Brokers Hideout.
Brokers Hideout enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping any land you control.
Resolve the Brokers Hideout trigger, causing you to sacrifice it, then search your library for a basic Forest, Plains or Island card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, and gain 1 life.
The basic land enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaretiller.
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {G}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Brokers Hideout from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

2387-3430-4038.notablePrerequisites: Farmstead Gleaner has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2387-3430-4038.description:
Activate Farmstead Gleaner to add {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner to untap itself.
Repeat.

454-1486-1651.description:
Cause Magda to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Magda and another artifact, targeting Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Magda.
Repeat from step 2.

337-776-1329-4370.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Embraal Gear-Smasher do not have summoning sickness.
337-776-1329-4370.description:
Tap Embraal Gear-Smasher, sacrificing Darksteel Relic to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Darksteel Relic.
Cast Darksteel Relic.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

618-4262-5200-5313.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control at least five additional creatures.
618-4262-5200-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Angel of Renewal with haste.
The token enters gaining you at least 9 life.
Pay 9 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}.
Pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

868-2492-3368-4833.description:
Cast Bonus Round by paying {R}{R}.
Cast Desperate Ritual by paying {R}.
Bonus Round triggers, creating a copy of Desperate Ritual.
Resolve the Desperate Ritual copy, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {3}{R}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Desperate Ritual.
Bonus Round triggers, creating a copy of Reiterate.
Resolve the Reiterate copy, creating a copy of Desperate Ritual.
Resolve the second Desperate Ritual copy, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the first copy of Desperate Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 5.
